ai.seo_question: What does 'Dhawata Afnan' mean in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase highlights the infinite variety and perfection of Paradise's flora, reflecting the divine attribute of *Al-Wahhab* (The Bestower). It serves as a tangible sign of God's mercy, contrasting the transient nature of worldly vegetation with the eternal, ever-renewing bounty of the hereafter.
